subject.title: fix(codex): backoff startup connection-close retries and surface exhaustion (#83959) [AI-assisted]

question: Should this Codex startup fix land as a bounded 5-attempt backoff now, or should the author replace it with an explicit replacement-server readiness gate before merge?
rationale: The code path and proof support the fix, but the patch deliberately changes the availability latency envelope for persistent startup closes and issue discussion raised readiness-gate preferences that require maintainer intent.

options.title: Land bounded backoff
options.body: Accept the small added persistent-failure latency because the PR fixes the reported transient startup-close window with focused tests and real subprocess proof.

options.title: Require readiness gate
options.body: Ask for retry admission to be based on an explicit replacement-server readiness signal instead of sleeping between attempts.

options.title: Sequence with adjacent startup PR
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide how it should compose with the initialize-timeout work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89442.

recommendation.title: Land bounded backoff
recommendation.body: Accept the small added persistent-failure latency because the PR fixes the reported transient startup-close window with focused tests and real subprocess proof.
